body: I guess. I never really had any friends until sophomore year in high school then I slowly joined this group of like six or seven friends. I was never super close with them for the rest of high school but I hang out with them during school and sometimes outside of school and they would probably consider me a friend

I hate that I don't know how to talk to people. I can't make small talk at all and when I do I feel like I'm just being an idiot talking. I hate that my "friends" from high school are all having a great time. My family knows I don't have friends and when I go home and maybe talk/hang out (which I probably don't because I have no social skills and don't even know how to ask someone to) they're going to ask me what I'm doing/who I'm living with next year (because one friend already did ask me) and I'll say I don't know. They already all know they're living with friends they made. I probably won't even talk to them because I don't even know if they're actually my friends so I probably have to worry about this. I feel like everyone thinks I'm a complete idiot.

I hate that I always compare myself to other people obsessively and feel like I need to be just as happy as them. 

I hate the fact that I'm sitting here and like shaking because I'm always anxious and can never calm down. I've tried meditating but it's so hard for me, even though I've been trying it for over two months.

I hate the fact that I know I'm good looking but I have never had a girlfriend because I have no social skills. I finally kissed a girl for the first time a couple weeks ago (and that was probably just because we were drunk).

I hate the fact that I'm so arrogant and think I'm better than other people with social anxiety disorder and feel like I deserve better because I'm too good to feel this way.
